note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools "" --disable-slash-commands --output-format json` sessions in an empty folder; the prompt goes in on stdin; control without the skill, with-skill run gets SKILL.md and references/commands.md prepended. Grade from the answer text against the assertions. The baseline failures come from one real long session on a repo with Projects (classic) data. Run 2026-10-14 after the rescope: all five scenarios, one control and one with-skill run each, all ten launched in the same turn on the same model. Tokens are from the JSON usage: "in" sums input, cache-read and cache-creation tokens (about 245k of it is the cached default session context), "out" is output tokens. A scenario counts only when its control fails and the skill would load for its prompt; "counts" in each result says which ones do.

evals.prompt: `gh pr edit 12 --body-file body.md` just failed with: "GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated in favor of the new Projects experience ... (repository.pullRequest.projectCards)". Update the title and body of PR 12 and set label `bug` on it. Exact commands only; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: no second gh pr edit; PATCH repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/12 with -f title and -F body=@file; POST .../issues/12/labels with -f 'labels[]=bug'; reads the body back
assertions: does not retry gh pr edit
uses gh api PATCH on pulls/12 with -F body=@<file>
reads the body back after the edit
evals.source: user session: gh pr edit retried three times on the same projectCards error
baseline_failures: retried gh pr edit three times on the same GraphQL error

results.control: fail, 28 s, $0.10, 254189 in / 783 out tokens: PATCH pulls/12 with -F body=@body.md, POST issues/12/labels, no retry of gh pr edit, but no read-back of the body (assertion 4 fails). The 2026-10-14 control run before the rescope passed this scenario, so the baseline is 1 failure in 2 runs.
results.with_skill: pass, 30 s, $0.17, 257670 in / 1138 out tokens: copies the body to $(mktemp -d)/pr-12.md, PATCH with -F body=@"$f", labels through issues/12/labels, 'gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/12 --jq .body | diff - "$f" && echo same'

evals.prompt: PR 12 is approved at head abc1234. I pushed one more commit a minute ago. Wait for its checks and squash merge it. `gh pr view` fails with a projectCards error here. Exact commands only; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: compares the pushed SHA with .head.sha from the API before reading check-runs; waits for completed runs of that SHA; merges with PUT pulls/12/merge -f merge_method=squash -f sha=<head>; asks for the merge OK against the new head
assertions: compares the pushed head SHA with the one the API returns before reading checks
reads check-runs of that SHA, not of abc1234
merge call carries sha=<head> so a later push cannot merge unseen code
treats HTTP 409 as a moved head and goes back to the checks
evals.source: user session: merged without the sha guard; polled checks of the previous head
baseline_failures: polled checks of the previous head

results.control: fail, 31 s, $0.10, 254156 in / 1095 out tokens: reads .head.sha once and tells the user to check by eye that it is not abc1234 (no comparison with the pushed SHA, no wait; assertion 1 fails); gh pr checks 12 --watch reads the PR's current head, not a pinned SHA (assertion 2 fails); gh pr merge --match-head-commit "$HEAD" (assertion 3 passes); no handling of a refused merge or moved head (assertion 4 fails)
results.with_skill: pass, 36 s, $0.19, 257637 in / 1952 out tokens: waits until .head.sha equals git rev-parse HEAD, reads check-runs of $pushed with --paginate, 'gh api -X PUT repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/12/merge -f merge_method=squash -f sha="$pushed"', 'HTTP 409 means the head moved again. That new head needs its own checks and your OK, so go back to step 1.'

evals.prompt: I have PR 31 (closes #28) and PR 32 (closes #29). Write the body of each and update both PRs. `gh pr edit` fails with projectCards here. Exact commands only; do not run them.

reads each body back after the edit

evals.prompt: PR 45 body says "Closes #44" and it just merged into main. Report that #44 is closed and set its milestone to v0.7. Exact commands only; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: reads issues/44 state after the merge; closes it with a comment naming PR 45 if still open; sets milestone by number from the milestones list; re-reads the milestone before reporting
assertions: verifies the state of #44 instead of assuming the keyword closed it
sets the milestone by number found in the milestones list
re-reads the milestone before reporting it applied
evals.source: user session: closing keyword missing from the PR body; milestone API lagged after a write

results.control: fail, 26 s, $0.14, 254138 in / 666 out tokens: checks state with gh issue view 44 --json state,stateReason (assertion 1 passes); sets the milestone with gh issue edit 44 --milestone v0.7 by title (assertion 2 fails) and does not read it back (assertion 3 fails)
results.with_skill: pass, 32 s, $0.18, 257619 in / 1376 out tokens: reads issues/44 state up to three times, finds the v0.7 number in milestones?state=all, PATCH -F milestone="$m", reads the milestone back
results.why_not_counted: the prompt has no projectCards error, so the rescoped description does not load the skill; assertion 2 only matters under REST. The skill no longer has a closing-keyword step.
